say:1:1422675001:1.text: The Deer Spirit has witnessed your deeds and reveals your next path.
say:1:1422675001:1.source_cn: 诸位，你们所做的一切，鹿灵都已知晓。

say:2:1422675002:1.text: She will now lead us to the next trial: bonding with the geo leylines.
say:2:1422675002:1.source_cn: 而祂也予以指引，此处则是考验的下一步——与地脉建立联系。

say:3:1422675003:1.text: To connect with the aqua leylines, he soaked in the river. So, to bond with the geo leylines... he doesn't need to bury himself, does he?
say:3:1422675003:1.source_cn: 与水脉联系要泡到河里，与地脉联系，总不能是挖个坑埋了吧？

say:4:1422675004:1.text: Haha! No, no such drastic measures. The Taran River's trial was to prove his worthiness of redemption.
say:4:1422675004:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，不用不用，浸入水中，是塔兰河的考验——为了证明...

say:5:1422675005:1.text: Now that Indris has shown his sincerity, we've reached the stage of true redemption.
say:5:1422675005:1.source_cn: 而在因度厄证明自身的诚意之后，此处则是赎罪的部分了。

say:6:1422675006:1.text: The Vaduso Mountains once flourished under Misarte's grace, their leylines whole.
say:6:1422675006:1.source_cn: 本来整个瓦度索山脉都处于弥萨忒的庇佑下，地脉也并无损坏。

say:7:1422675007:1.text: But Eomir's sins corrupted and polluted Rainford. It's been cut off from the earth.
say:7:1422675007:1.source_cn: 可之前伊米尔在此处造下罪孽，让沐霖村被腐化污染。这里已...

say:8:1422675008:1.text: Indris must bring Rainford back into Misarte's embrace.
say:8:1422675008:1.source_cn: 现在需要因度厄协助，让沐霖村回归弥萨忒的怀抱。

say:9:1422675009:1.source_cn: 多么顺理成章的考验啊……

say:10:1422675010:1.text: Ahem. Let's call it a win-win.

say:11:1422675011:1.text: What do I need to do?
say:11:1422675011:1.source_cn: 理应如此。请问，我需要怎么做？

say:12:1422675012:1.text: Truthfully, <style="stress"><player_name></style> did half the work already.
say:12:1422675012:1.male: Truthfully, <style="stress"><player_name></style> did half the work already.
say:12:1422675012:1.female: Truthfully, <style="stress"><player_name></style> did half the work already.

say:13:1422675013:1.text: He's already taken care of the hardest part—purifying the corruption. Now we only need to relink the leylines.
say:13:1422675013:1.source_cn: 原本这个考验最艰难的就是驱逐邪恶的污染与腐化，但梅林已...
say:13:1422675013:1.male: He's already taken care of the hardest part—purifying the corruption. Now we only need to relink the leylines.
say:13:1422675013:1.female: She's already taken care of the hardest part—purifying the corruption. Now we only need to relink the leylines.

say:14:1422675014:1.text: But Eomir's experiments drained the magic in the local geo leyline.
say:14:1422675014:1.source_cn: 问题只在于，由于伊米尔的实验，这里地脉的魔力遭到过度抽...

say:15:1422675015:1.source_cn: 必须要<style=highlight>纯净的土元素精...

say:18:1422675017:1.text: That's the tricky part. The corruption lingers. Pure earth essence is rare in the Vaduso Mountains.
say:18:1422675017:1.source_cn: 这倒是有点难了，腐化的影响尚未消除彻底。瓦度索山脉虽有...

say:19:1422675018:1.text: Earth elementals... Sal'thorin has plenty of <style="highlight">stone wardens</style>—we might be able to draw essence from them.
say:19:1422675018:1.source_cn: ……土元素，萨洛克兰有很多土元素。或许能在那里找到纯净...

say:21:1422675019:1.text: Good idea. You'll need to act fast.
say:21:1422675019:1.source_cn: 这确实是个主意，但你们的行动要快。

say:23:1422675020:2.text: I'll also go help—I mean supervise. As Misarte's witness, I must ensure nothing goes wrong.
say:23:1422675020:2.source_cn: 我也去帮……我也去监督，作为弥萨忒的见证人，我要确保不...

choice_prompt:24:1422675020.text: I'll also go help—I mean supervise. As Misarte's witness, I must ensure nothing goes wrong.
choice_prompt:24:1422675020.source_cn: 我也去帮……我也去监督，作为弥萨忒的见证人，我要确保不会出什么问题。

say:25:1422675021:1.text: I-I won't interfere! This is Indris' trial. I'm just... observing!
say:25:1422675021:1.source_cn: 呃……我不会帮忙的，这是因度厄的考验，而我是弥萨忒的代...

say:26:1422675023:1.text: Please go ahead. I'll start locating a site where we can reconnect the geo leylines.
say:26:1422675023:1.source_cn: 呵呵呵，那么，去吧，我会在这里，先找到适合修复的地脉节点。

say:27:1422675024:1.text: Also, Merlin, I might need to borrow your familiars for a bit.
say:27:1422675024:1.source_cn: 此外，梅林，我可能要借用你的小使魔一段时间。
say:27:1422675024:1.male: Also, Merlin, I might need to borrow your familiars for a bit.
say:27:1422675024:1.female: Also, Merlin, I might need to borrow your familiars for a bit.

say:29:1422675025:1.text: Restoring the local connection is only part of the work. I plan to use this opportunity to reorganize the entire leyline structure here.
say:29:1422675025:1.source_cn: 重建地域的联系只是一部分工作，我想借机把此处的地脉整体...

say:30:1422675026:1.text: If this can mark the beginning of Sal'thorin's recovery, we can deepen this region's harmony.
say:30:1422675026:1.source_cn: 如果能借着萨洛克兰一支回归为契机，让这一带区域深度融合...

say:31:1422675027:0.text: Bryon can handle outside surveillance, but your two familiars have impressed me with their understanding of the local leylines.
say:31:1422675027:0.source_cn: 布莱恩能够负责外围的探查，但论起对此处地脉的理解，你的...

choice_prompt:32:1422675027.text: Bryon can handle outside surveillance, but your two familiars have impressed me with their understanding of the local leylines.
choice_prompt:32:1422675027.source_cn: 布莱恩能够负责外围的探查，但论起对此处地脉的理解，你的两位使魔可是给我留下了很深刻的印象。

say:34:1422675028:1.text: Hmm... Chippy would rather stay with you, Magister...
say:34:1422675028:1.source_cn: 唔，还是想多和主人一起行动……
say:34:1422675028:1.male: Hmm... Chippy would rather stay with you, Magister...
say:34:1422675028:1.female: Hmm... Chippy would rather stay with you, Magister...

say:35:1422675029:1.text: But it's true that we can be more useful here.
say:35:1422675029:1.source_cn: 不过，对这一带的地脉，确实我和满满更能派上用场。

say:36:1422675030:0.text: Then, please be careful on your journey!
say:36:1422675030:0.source_cn: 那，主人路上一定要多小心呀！
say:36:1422675030:0.male: Then, please be careful on your journey!
say:36:1422675030:0.female: Then, please be careful on your journey!

choice:32:0:1.text: Are you two okay with that?
choice:32:0:1.male: Are you two okay with that?
choice:32:0:1.female: Are you two okay with that?

say:40:1422675022:1.text: I said nothing! I'll just be there to observe... really.
say:40:1422675022:1.source_cn: 我什么都没说，我也不会帮忙，只是去见证下情况……真的。
